Wanted to share my honest review with everyone on Jan 6th I fell at home and got back issues one of my friend suggested me to Beramji’s and then I consulted the doctor Dr guided me everything abt the back issue firstly as everyone I also was also in doubt after seeing the reviews but I had to take the chance I was having after a week I started my treatment .. it healed slowly but within 15days by the help of doct I was healed 100% it’s lil costly but you need to trust them if you really don’t want to stay in pain I got healthy and healed perfectly and now I have started my wife’s treatment with them
thankyou so much for the down to earth and kind staff and also to the doctor
A very big thank you❤️

featured_reviews.review_text:
The Kerala Ayurveda Center- Very good authentic therapists and Ayurvedic centre has really helped me recharge and reset my back and ankle weakness and injuries , also a great detox and rejuvenation/detox.

I have Extreme regard and respect for Dr Beramji and his skill and experience for testing almost all injuries and all orthopaedic treatment.
When I lived overseas  I would fly back to seek his guidance and treatment and expertise to treat me!

Accunpunture, physio and all Ortho related treatments - no question the best centre and doctors/ staff. Very friendly and courteous receptionist staff as well.
